rationale: Sharon's TheAgentic.Ai is building production-ready AI agent infrastructure for high-stakes industries like biotech and fintech, while Moe is founding Flowzy in the developer-tools and AI-agent space—both operating at the intersection of LLM tooling and agent systems. Sharon's infrastructure-layer expertise and Moe's full-stack technical depth (TypeScript, Python, Rust) across multiple domains create a natural complement for exploring how agent platforms can serve verticals that demand reliability.
intro_message: Sharon, meet Moe — you're both building in the AI-agent and LLM-tooling space, and his developer-tools background could be a useful sounding board for how production agent systems reach technical practitioners.
